description: Convert the default greenfield example and legacy adoption walkthrough into complete natural-English references. The example must demonstrate the same Product Feature Coding Rules and Progress contracts that new English projects receive.
acceptance_criteria: The default greenfield example contains English Product Feature and Coding Rules natural-language content
The legacy walkthrough explains the complete adoption flow in natural English
Example Feature IDs detail files counts dependencies and JSON remain consistent
The example does not introduce a duplicated translated workflow source tree
notes: Human acceptance passed on the final repaired documentation on 2026-08-26. The complete English Greenfield reference includes Product, Features, the rendered four-layer Coding Rules, project-specific platform/language rules, methodology configuration, and correctly archived Progress. The Legacy walkthrough demonstrates complete dependency-ordered Product modules, exact anchored Feature sources, pre-bootstrap evidence, installation, verification, and gradual adoption without a localized workflow-source tree. Automated verification: all 54 repository tests passed; target sources contain no Han text; JSON, rule references, exact template rendering, Markdown anchors, machine state, and git diff checks passed. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F023, must_fix: 0, suggest: 2, acceptable: 2).
